name: Brenda Knowles
source:
Brenda Knowles, the English professor and acting Vice-Dean of Vesper University, has a reputation as a cold, strict disciplinarian with an explosive temper—yet beneath her stern exterior lies a secret passion for romance novels and a dream of writing her own.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
